# NivoraFi

> Fixed Yield & Yield Tokenization AMM Protocol built natively on Stellar Soroban.

NivoraFi splits yield-bearing assets (such as Blend Protocol bUSDC and XLM vaults) into Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT), enabling fixed-rate yield, yield leverage, and liquidity provision via a time-decaying log-normal AMM.

## Core Architecture

- **Standardized Yield (SY):** Wraps underlying Stellar/Blend yield-bearing positions into a unified Soroban SEP-41 token interface.
- **Principal Token (PT):** Redeemable 1:1 for underlying SY at maturity, trading at a discount prior to maturity to lock in a fixed APY.
- **Yield Token (YT):** Captures all variable Blend lending yield until maturity; traded in a single unified PT/SY pool via 2-step Picard iteration flash swaps without fragmenting liquidity.
- **1-Click Atomic Rollover:** Migrates matured PT positions directly into a new active maturity pool (PT or LP) in a single Soroban transaction.
- **Persistent Event Indexer & BFF:** Next.js BFF proxy (`/api/indexer/*`) backed by a persistent SQLite Soroban event indexer with `x-indexer-secret` origin authentication.

## Active Markets (Stellar Testnet)

- `usdc-90d` — bUSDC 90-Day Fixed Yield Market
- `usdc-30d` — bUSDC 30-Day Fixed Yield Market
- `xlm-90d` — XLM 90-Day Fixed Yield Market
- `usdc-matured` — bUSDC Matured Settlement & Rollover Market

## Key Routes

- `/` — Protocol Overview & Live Yield Desk
- `/markets` — Active Yield Markets Explorer
- `/trade/[market]` — PT/YT Swap, Mint, Liquidity, Redeem & Rollover Desk
- `/pools` — Liquidity Pools & Live Indexer Analytics
- `/portfolio` — User Balances, Pending Yield & Position Management
- `/terms` — Non-Custodial Protocol Terms of Service
- `/privacy` — Zero-Cookie & Zero-Tracker Privacy Policy
